name: Dual Contouring with Octree Simplification
definition: A recursive algorithm that collapses internal octree nodes into 'pseudo-leaf' nodes by solving a Quadratic Error Function (QEF) to find a representative vertex position, enabling mesh simplification while preserving topological features defined by the sign configuration of child nodes.
summary: Dual Contouring with Octree Simplification is a surface extraction method that reduces vertex count by merging internal octree nodes into pseudo-leaves while preserving sharp features.
